messages.subject: For Stuart McDonald | Copper development, government relations and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Bergot,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Stuart McDonald, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Taseko's copper-development and operating agenda requires close alignment across government, permitting, communities, sustainability commitments and operating teams. That interface closely matches the work I lead today inside a major mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I manage senior institutional engagement, coordinate complex stakeholder matters across corporate and technical functions, and translate external commitments into accountable owners, evidence, timelines and escalation. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would value a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, social performance and copper-project execution might support Taseko's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Taseko Mines.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
